platform.name: Leap
platform.lms: Proprietary learning portal called Leap — built for practice-first, project-based learning

mentors.description: Industry professionals with hands-on experience at top tech and financial companies
mentors.offline_note: Students in offline mode get direct in-person access to mentors and industry professionals at the Gradious office

platform.doubt_sessions: Live doubt clearing sessions twice a week
platform.standups: Daily standups for self-paced learners to stay on track
platform.learning_approach: Practice-first learning — learn by doing with hands-on exercises, not just watching videos
features: Hands-on coding exercises embedded in every lesson

online.description: Student takes the course remotely from anywhere
online.mentor_access: Online mentorship via scheduled sessions and chat

offline.description: Student comes to the Gradious office in Hyderabad for in-person training
offline.mentor_access: Direct in-person access to mentors and industry professionals at the office

training_modes.note: Online and offline are independent of self-paced and live-classes. A student can choose any combination — e.g. offline + self-paced, or online + live classes.

self_paced.description: Pre-recorded video lessons — learn at your own pace, anytime
includes: Daily standups to stay on track

live_classes.description: Scheduled live sessions with an instructor

placements.placement_rate: 70% of eligible students placed within 3 months
placements.placement_description: We have partnered with product-based companies that actively hire trained candidates from Gradious. Our placement support includes resume preparation, mock interviews, and direct referrals to our hiring partners.
placements.for_more_details: For specific company names, active openings, and detailed placement process — our admissions expert can walk you through everything on a call.

admissions.batch_frequency: New live batches start every 2nd week of the month
admissions.enrollment_process: Contact our admissions team or schedule a call with an expert for exact upcoming batch dates and seat availability.
